criteria.forum: Community forum conversations, discussion threads, group posts, replies, or member activity notifications.
criteria.promotions: Legitimate marketing, sales, discounts, product offers, newsletters, or commercial campaigns.
criteria.social_media: Notifications from social networks about follows, likes, mentions, direct activity, groups, or recommended content.
criteria.spam: Unsolicited, deceptive, suspicious, irrelevant, or low-quality bulk messages, including scams and phishing-like content.
criteria.updates: Operational, account, product, service, order, billing, travel, or informational status updates that are not verification codes.
criteria.verify_code: One-time passwords, authentication codes, account verification codes, login codes, or security confirmation tokens.
